en: Some people think that the government is wasting money on the arts and that this money could be better spent elsewhere. To what extent do you agree with this view?
zh: 有些人認為政府把錢浪費在藝術上，這筆錢用於其他地方會更好。你在多大程度上同意這個觀點？

en: Many people think that museums and galleries should only show work from local artists rather than work from other countries. Do you agree?
zh: 許多人認為博物館和美術館只應展出本地藝術家的作品，不應展出外國作品。你同意嗎？

en: Art is considered an essential part of all cultures throughout the world. However, these days fewer and fewer people appreciate art and turn their focus to science, technology and business. Why do you think that is? What could be done to encourage more people to take interest in the arts?
zh: 藝術被視為世界各地文化的重要部分。然而，如今欣賞藝術的人越來越少，更多人把注意力轉向科學、科技和商業。你認為原因是甚麼？可以怎樣鼓勵更多人關注藝術？

en: Some people think that art is an essential subject for children at school while others think it is a waste of time. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為藝術是學校兒童不可缺少的科目，另一些人則認為學藝術浪費時間。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Artists need a certain amount of freedom to develop their creativity. Some people think that artists should have total freedom to express any thoughts and ideas. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 藝術家需要一定的自由才能發揮創意。有些人認為藝術家應有完全的自由，表達任何思想和意念。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Most artists earn low salaries and should therefore receive funding from the government so that they can continue their work. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 大部分藝術家的收入偏低，因此應獲政府資助，讓他們繼續創作。你在多大程度上同意？

en: In some countries, a few people earn extremely high salaries. Some people think that this is good for a country, while others believe that the government should control salaries and limit the amount people can earn. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 在一些國家，少數人賺取極高薪酬。有些人認為這對國家有好處，另一些人則認為政府應管制薪酬，限制個人收入。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: More and more business meetings are taking place online. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
zh: 越來越多商務會議在線上舉行。這個趨勢有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Due to the development and rapid expansion of supermarkets in some countries, many small, local businesses are unable to compete. Some people think that the closure of local businesses will bring about the death of local communities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 一些國家的超級市場迅速擴張，令許多本地小商戶難以競爭。有些人認為本地商戶結業會導致社區衰落。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Companies should provide sports and social facilities for local communities. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 公司應為當地社區提供運動和社交設施。你在多大程度上同意？

en: If the product is good and meets consumer needs, then advertising is unnecessary. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 如果產品質素良好，而且符合消費者需要，便毋須賣廣告。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Large businesses have big budgets for marketing and promotion and as a result, people gravitate towards buying their products. What problems does this cause? What could be done to encourage people to buy local products?
zh: 大型企業擁有充裕的市場推廣和宣傳預算，因此人們傾向購買它們的產品。這造成甚麼問題？可以怎樣鼓勵人們購買本地產品？

en: Some countries encourage foreign companies to open in their country. Many people think that the government should focus on encouraging local business rather than foreign businesses. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 一些國家鼓勵外國企業進駐。有許多人認為政府應重點支持本地企業，而非外國企業。你在多大程度上同意？

en: An increasing number of people are buying what they need online. What are the advantages and disadvantages for both individuals and companies of shopping online?
zh: 越來越多人在網上購買所需物品。網購對個人和公司各有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Marketing and promotion are key to a successful business. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 市場推廣和宣傳是企業成功的關鍵。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The performance of staff can have a significant impact on the success of a company. What can companies do to increase staff productivity?
zh: 員工表現會對公司的成功產生重大影響。公司可以怎樣提高員工生產力？

en: Some companies have uniforms for their staff which must be worn at all times. What are the advantages for a company of having a uniform? Are there any benefits of having a uniform for the staff?
zh: 有些公司規定員工在工作期間必須穿着制服。制服對公司有甚麼好處？對員工有沒有好處？

en: In many countries, it is common for families to own and run their own business. Some people think this is the best way to run a business, while others consider this a potential source of problems. What is your opinion?
zh: 在許多國家，家族擁有並經營企業十分普遍。有些人認為這是經營企業的最佳方式，另一些人則認為這可能帶來問題。你有甚麼看法？

en: Some people think that when recruiting, companies should aim to take on people who are innovative and able to work independently while others consider that they should recruit people who are able to work in a team and follow instructions. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為企業招聘時應選擇有創意、能獨立工作的人；另一些人認為企業應聘用善於團隊合作和遵從指示的人。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that the only way to have success in business is to have a unique product. What factors do you think influence the success of a company?
zh: 有些人認為企業要成功，唯一方法是推出獨特產品。你認為哪些因素會影響公司的成敗？

en: Small businesses should avoid recruiting young women who do not have their own family in order to avoid paying maternity leave later on. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 為免日後支付產假薪酬，小企業應避免聘用尚未有家庭的年輕女性。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Sales companies should recruit people who are hungry for money as they will make the most dedicated workers. Do you think money is the driving force behind hard work? What factors should be taken into consideration when recruiting staff for sales positions?
zh: 銷售公司應聘用渴望賺錢的人，因為他們會是最投入的員工。你認為金錢是努力工作的主要動力嗎？招聘銷售人員時還應考慮哪些因素？

en: The reason that most individuals are in debt is due to the overuse as well as irresponsible use of credit cards. Banks should not issue credit cards unless they are completely sure of an individual’s ability to pay back their debts. To what extent do you agree with this?
zh: 大部分人負債，是因為過度及不負責任地使用信用卡。銀行只有在完全確定申請人有能力還債時，才應發出信用卡。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people believe that the higher a product is priced, the more likely it is that people will want to buy it. To what extent does price influence potential buyers? What other factors influence people to buy a product?
zh: 有些人相信產品定價越高，消費者越想購買。價格在多大程度上影響潛在買家？還有哪些因素會影響購買決定？

en: Some people think that the only way to judge someone’s success in business is by the amount of money they make. Is money a true indicator of the success of a business? In what other ways could success in a business be measured?
zh: 有些人認為衡量一個人在商業上是否成功，只須看他賺了多少錢。金錢能真正反映企業的成功嗎？還可以用甚麼方式衡量？

en: It is common practice for some students to take a gap year between high school and university in order to do charitable work abroad in underdeveloped countries. What are the advantages and disadvantages for young people of doing volunteer work?
zh: 有些學生會在中學畢業後、大學入學前休學一年，前往發展程度較低的國家做義工。這對年輕人有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Rich countries are getting richer while poor countries are getting poorer. What is the cause of this? What could be done to solve this problem?
zh: 富裕國家越來越富裕，貧窮國家則越來越貧窮。原因是甚麼？可以怎樣解決這個問題？

en: Some people think that it is better for a country’s economy for people to spend money, while others believe that it would be better for people to save money. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為人民多消費有利國家經濟，另一些人則認為多儲蓄更好。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people fail in school, but end up being successful in life. Why do you think that is the case? What is the most important thing to succeed in life?
zh: 有些人在學校成績不理想，日後卻取得成功。你認為原因是甚麼？要在人生中取得成功，最重要的是甚麼？

en: Some people think that ambition is essential for success. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為雄心是成功的必要條件。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The first impression you have of a person is the best way to judge a person. Do you agree?
zh: 對一個人的第一印象，是判斷這個人最好的方法。你同意嗎？

en: Some people enjoy change in life, while other people try to avoid it. What are the advantages and disadvantages of both approaches?
zh: 有些人喜歡生活出現變化，另一些人則盡量避免改變。這兩種態度各有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: People were stressed in previous generations compared to now. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 與現在相比，過去幾代人承受更多壓力。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that teenagers are happier than adults, but others do not agree. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為青少年比成年人快樂，另一些人則不同意。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Nowadays celebrities are more famous for their glamour and wealth than for their achievements, and this sets a bad example to young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 現今名人出名更多因為外表光鮮和財富，而非成就；這為年輕人樹立了壞榜樣。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Some celebrities feel that the media violates their personal space and shares their private life publicly, while others feel it is just part of being famous. What is your opinion?
zh: 有些名人認為媒體侵犯私人空間、公開他們的私生活；另一些人認為這是成名的一部分。你有甚麼看法？

en: The way someone dresses speaks volumes about their personality. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 一個人的衣着能充分反映其性格。你在多大程度上同意？

en: With an increasing population communicating via the internet and text messaging, face to face communication will become a thing of the past. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 越來越多人透過互聯網和文字訊息溝通，面對面交流終將成為過去。你在多大程度上同意？

en: More and more businesses as well as individuals are choosing to communicate either professionally or socially using technology rather than being face to face. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using technology for communicating.
zh: 越來越多企業和個人選擇以科技進行工作或社交溝通，減少面對面交流。討論科技溝通的優點和缺點。

en: Many young children have unsupervised access to the internet and are using the internet to socialise with others. This can lead to a number of dangerous situations which can be threatening for children. What problems do children face when going online without parental supervision? How can these problems be solved?
zh: 許多幼童在沒有監督下使用互聯網，並在線上與人社交，可能因此遇上危險。兒童缺乏家長監督時上網會面對甚麼問題？這些問題可以怎樣解決？

en: Some people think that being able to communicate with others online is breaking down geographical barriers and enabling people, who would normally never have the chance to meet, to communicate. What are the advantages of international communication online? Are there any disadvantages to this?
zh: 有些人認為網上交流打破地域界限，使原本沒有機會見面的人能夠溝通。國際網上交流有甚麼優點？有沒有缺點？

en: With the development of online communication, people will never be alone and will always be able to make new friends. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 隨着網上通訊發展，人們再也不會感到孤單，並且隨時能結識新朋友。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Communication through text messaging and other instant forms of online communication is short and basic. Some people think this will be the death of grammar and spelling. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 短訊及其他即時網上通訊方式通常簡短而簡單。有些人認為這將使文法和拼寫逐漸消失。你同意還是不同意？

en: Some people think that intelligence is innate, while others think that we can improve our intelligence through learning. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為智力與生俱來，另一些人則認為智力可以透過學習提高。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Our personalities are predetermined as a result of our genes before we are born and there is nothing that can be done to alter our character traits. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 我們的性格在出生前已由基因決定，個人的性格特徵無法改變。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Many management interviews are based around assessing not only a person’s level of experience and knowledge but also their personality. Is leadership an innate skill? What other characteristics do companies look for in a manager?
zh: 許多管理職位面試除了評估經驗和知識，也會評估個性。領導才能是否與生俱來？公司還會尋找管理者具備哪些特質？

en: Some people think that women are generally more peaceful than men as their characters are naturally more nurturing than aggressive. To what extent do you agree with this?
zh: 有些人認為女性通常比男性平和，因為女性天性較富養育之心，較少攻擊性。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think our first impression of someone is important, while others think we should not judge another person so quickly and should take our time to know them better. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為對別人的第一印象很重要；另一些人認為不應急於評判，應花時間加深了解。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: The crime rate nowadays is decreasing compared to the past due to advanced technology which can prevent and solve crime. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 如今犯罪率比過去下降，是因為先進科技能預防並偵破罪案。你同意還是不同意？

en: Many criminals commit further crimes as soon as they are released from prison. What do you think are the causes of this? What possible solutions can you suggest?
zh: 許多罪犯出獄後很快再次犯罪。你認為原因是甚麼？你有甚麼可行的解決方法？

en: It is often thought that the increase in juvenile crime can be attributed to violence in the media. Do you agree that this is the main cause of juvenile crime? What solutions can you offer to deal with this situation?
zh: 有人認為青少年犯罪增加，主要與媒體暴力內容有關。你同意這是主要原因嗎？你會提出甚麼解決方法？

en: In some societies, the number of crimes committed by teenagers is growing. Some people think that regardless of age, teenagers who commit major crimes should receive adult punishment. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些社會的青少年犯罪數目正在上升。有人認為犯下嚴重罪行的青少年，無論年齡大小，都應接受與成人相同的刑罰。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some countries are struggling with an increase in the rate of crime. Many people think that having more police on the streets is the only way to reduce crime. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 一些國家的犯罪率不斷上升。許多人認為增加街上的警察，是減少罪案的唯一方法。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that women should not be allowed to work in the police force. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為女性不應加入警隊。你同意還是不同意？

en: Many crimes are often related to the consumption of alcohol. Some people think that the best way to reduce the crime rate is to ban alcohol. Do you think this is an effective measure against crime? What other solutions can you suggest?
zh: 許多罪案與飲酒有關。有人認為禁酒是降低犯罪率的最佳方法。你認為這種做法有效嗎？你還會提出甚麼方法？

en: Some people think certain prisoners should be made to do unpaid community work instead of being put behind bars. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為部分囚犯應從事無薪社區服務，代替入獄。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Many people believe that having a fixed punishment for all crimes is more efficient. What are the advantages and disadvantages of having a fixed punishment?
zh: 許多人認為對所有罪行採用固定刑罰更有效率。固定刑罰制度有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Some people think that the government should be responsible for crime prevention, while others believe that it is the responsibility of the individual to protect themselves. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為政府應負責預防罪案，另一些人則認為個人有責任保護自己。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: The death penalty is the best way to control and reduce serious crime. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 死刑是控制及減少嚴重罪案的最佳方法。你在多大程度上同意？

en: While it is sometimes thought that prison is the best place for criminals, others believe that there are better ways to deal with them. What is your opinion?
zh: 有些人認為監獄是安置罪犯最適合的地方，另一些人則認為還有更好的處理方式。你有甚麼看法？

en: Crime rate, in most countries, is often higher in urban areas than in rural areas. Why do you think that is? What can be done to reduce the crime rate?
zh: 大部分國家的城市犯罪率通常高於鄉村。你認為原因是甚麼？可以怎樣降低犯罪率？

en: Some people think that poverty is the reason behind most crimes. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為貧窮是大部分罪案的原因。你同意還是不同意？

en: Internet crime is increasing rapidly as more and more people are using the internet to make financial transactions. What can be done to tackle this problem?
zh: 隨着更多人透過互聯網進行金融交易，網絡罪案迅速增加。可以怎樣應對這個問題？

en: Some people think that the parents of children who commit crimes should also receive a punishment. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為犯罪兒童的父母也應受到懲罰。你同意還是不同意？

en: Some educationalists think that international exchange visits will benefit teenagers at school. To what extent do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
zh: 有些教育工作者認為國際交流探訪有助青少年學習。這種活動的優點在多大程度上超過缺點？

en: For centuries, reading, writing and maths have remained important parts of education. With the advent of computers, some people think computer skills should be added to this list as a fourth basic skill. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 數百年來，閱讀、寫作和數學一直是重要的教育內容。電腦普及後，有些人認為電腦技能應成為第四項基本能力。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The government should allocate more funding to teaching sciences rather than other subjects in order for a country to develop and progress. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 為促進國家發展，政府應投放更多資源教授科學，而非其他科目。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Discipline is an ever increasing problem in modern schools. Some people think that discipline should be the responsibility of teachers, while others think that this is the role of parents. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 學校紀律問題日益嚴重。有些人認為教師應負責管教學生，另一些人則認為這是家長的責任。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people believe that children should not be given homework every day, while others believe that they must get homework every day in order to be successful at school. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為兒童不應每天做功課，另一些人則認為每天做功課才能在學校取得好成績。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some children receive almost no encouragement from their parents regarding their performance at school, while other children receive too much pressure from their overenthusiastic parents which can have a negative impact on the child. Why do you think some parents put too much pressure on their children to perform well at school? What do you think the role of a parent should be in their child’s education?
zh: 有些兒童在學業上幾乎得不到父母鼓勵；另一些兒童則承受過分熱心的父母施加的壓力，可能受到負面影響。為甚麼有些父母向子女施加過大學業壓力？你認為父母應在子女教育中扮演甚麼角色？

en: The role of education is to prepare children for the modern world. Schools should cut art and music out of the curriculum so that children can focus on useful subjects such as information technology. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 教育的目的是幫助兒童為現代社會做好準備。學校應從課程刪去藝術與音樂，讓學生專注資訊科技等實用科目。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that students in high school should not waste their time studying literature, such as poems and novels. Do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為高中生花時間讀詩歌和小說等文學作品是浪費時間。你同意嗎？

en: Some parents believe that their children should do educational activities during their free time. Others say that in this way children are under pressure. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 有些家長認為孩子應在空閒時間參與教育活動；另一些人認為這會令孩子承受壓力。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that teachers should be able to ask disruptive children to leave the class. Do you think it is the best way to deal with a disruptive child in the classroom? What other solutions are there?
zh: 有些人認為教師應可要求擾亂課堂的學生離開。你認為這是處理課堂紀律問題的最佳方法嗎？還有甚麼其他方法？

en: Education should be accessible to people of all economic backgrounds. All levels of education, from primary school to tertiary education, should be free. To what extent do you agree with this opinion?
zh: 不同經濟背景的人都應有受教育的機會，從小學到大學的所有教育階段都應免費。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The current trend in education is to move away from traditional exams and instead have continuous assessment over the school year. What do you think of this trend?
zh: 教育界目前逐漸減少傳統考試，轉而在整個學年持續評估學生。你怎樣看這個趨勢？

en: Some people think that educated people are more valuable than people who have learned skills through experience. Do you think that educated people are the most valuable for society? What kinds of skills can people learn through experience that can benefit society?
zh: 有些人認為接受正規教育的人比透過經驗學到技能的人更有價值。你認為受過教育的人對社會最有價值嗎？人們可透過經驗學到哪些對社會有益的技能？

en: Being able to speak a foreign language is an advantage these days. Some people think that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school, while others think children should begin in secondary school. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 懂得外語在今天是一項優勢。有些人認為兒童應從小學開始學外語，另一些人則認為應到中學才開始。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: The gap between education in richer countries and education in poorer countries is a growing concern. What solutions can you suggest to deal with this situation?
zh: 富裕國家與貧窮國家之間的教育差距日益令人關注。你有甚麼解決方法？

en: Some schools are very strict about their school uniforms and the appearance of their pupils, while other schools have a very relaxed dress code. What are the advantages and disadvantages for children of wearing a school uniform?
zh: 有些學校對校服和學生儀容要求嚴格，另一些學校的衣着規定則較寬鬆。兒童穿校服有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: In some high schools, part of the curriculum requires students to participate in community work such as helping the elderly or disabled. In what way do children benefit from this? Do you think it should be part of the curriculum?
zh: 一些高中的課程要求學生參與社區服務，例如幫助長者或殘疾人士。兒童會因此得到甚麼好處？你認為社區服務應成為課程一部分嗎？

en: The best way to help underachieving pupils is to have compulsory after school activities which they must attend. This way they will become more involved in school and their grades will improve. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 幫助成績落後學生的最佳方法，是要求他們參加強制課後活動；這能提高他們對學校的投入程度，並改善成績。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that schools should invest more money in technology, such as more computers, while others think more money should be spent on teachers. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為學校應增加電腦等科技設備的投資，另一些人則認為應把更多資金用於教師。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that parents have the greatest influence on their child’s academic development, while others think that a child’s teacher has more influence. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為家長對子女學業發展的影響最大，另一些人則認為教師的影響更大。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: In some countries, girls and boys are educated in different schools rather than in the same school. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this?
zh: 一些國家的男孩和女孩分別在不同學校接受教育，而非同校上課。這種做法有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: In nearly all science courses at university, there are significantly more male students than female students. What is the reason for this? What could be done to balance out the numbers?
zh: 大學幾乎所有科學課程的男生人數都明顯多於女生。原因是甚麼？可以怎樣改善比例失衡的情況？

en: Some people think that it is beneficial for old people to learn something new while others believe that once a person is past 65 years of age it is too late to learn. What is your opinion?
zh: 有些人認為長者學習新事物有益，另一些人則認為過了六十五歲便太遲。你有甚麼看法？

en: It is thought by some that a school teacher’s role is to motivate and inspire students. However, other people believe that a teacher’s primary role is to pass on knowledge. What do you think is the role of a teacher?
zh: 有些人認為教師的職責是激勵學生，另一些人則認為教師的首要工作是傳授知識。你認為教師應扮演甚麼角色？

en: Fewer schools are requiring children to learn and improve their handwriting skills. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages of this trend?
zh: 要求兒童學習及改善手寫能力的學校越來越少。這個趨勢的優點是否超過缺點？

en: Human activity has had a negative impact on plants and animals around the world. Some people think that this cannot be changed, while others believe actions can be taken to bring about a change. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 人類活動對世界各地的動植物造成負面影響。有些人認為情況無法改變，另一些人則相信採取行動能帶來轉變。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: It is often said that governments spend too much money on projects to protect wildlife, although there are other, more important problems. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有人認為政府花太多錢保護野生動物，儘管還有更重要的問題需要處理。你同意還是不同意？

en: Some people think the best way to solve global environmental problems is to increase the cost of fuel. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為解決全球環境問題的最佳方法，是提高燃料價格。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Some people think an international car-free day is an effective way to reduce air pollution. Others think there are more effective ways to do this. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為設立國際無車日能有效減少空氣污染，另一些人則認為還有更有效的方法。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: While some people consider global warming to be the most pressing environmental problem which we have at the moment, others believe that deforestation has a more devastating impact on our world. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為全球暖化是目前最迫切的環境問題，另一些人則認為森林砍伐對世界的破壞更嚴重。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: The government should reduce the amount of money spent on local environmental problems and instead increase funding into urgent and more threatening issues such as global warming. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 政府應減少處理本地環境問題的開支，把更多資金投放在全球暖化等更緊急、更具威脅性的問題上。你在多大程度上同意？

en: With increasing populations and ever growing urban centers, many countries are losing their natural beauty spots. What benefits are there to protecting places of natural beauty? How can this be solved?
zh: 人口增加和城市擴張令許多國家的自然美景逐漸消失。保護自然景區有甚麼好處？這種流失可以怎樣解決？

en: Although many people value their public parks, this space could be better used for other purposes such as residential areas for the ever growing population or to develop business and boost economies. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this?
zh: 雖然許多人珍惜公共公園，但有人認為土地可用於住宅或商業發展，更能應對人口增長和推動經濟。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: With deforestation, urban development and illegal hunting, many animal species are becoming endangered as they lose their habitat and some are even threatened to the point of extinction. Do you think it is important to protect animals? What measures can be taken to deal with this problem?
zh: 森林砍伐、城市發展和非法狩獵令許多動物失去棲息地，甚至面臨滅絕。你認為保護動物重要嗎？可以採取甚麼措施？

en: Global warming is one of the biggest threats to our environment. What causes global warming? What solutions are there to this problem?
zh: 全球暖化是環境面對的最大威脅之一。全球暖化由甚麼造成？有甚麼解決方法？

en: Both governments and individuals are spending vast amounts of money protecting animals and their habitat. This money could be better spent dealing with fundamental issues in society such as poverty and health care. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 政府和個人都花費大量金錢保護動物及其棲息地。有人認為這些錢用於貧窮和醫療等社會基本問題會更好。你在多大程度上同意？

en: As a result of growth in some urban centers, the environment in those cities is deteriorating. How could this issue be tackled by both the government and individuals?
zh: 一些城市因發展而出現環境惡化。政府和個人可以怎樣共同處理？

en: Some people think that current environmental issues are global problems and should therefore be dealt with by the government while others believe that these problems can only be tackled by individuals. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為現時的環境問題屬於全球性問題，應由政府處理；另一些人則認為只有個人行動才能解決。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Global environmental issues are the responsibility of rich nations not of poorer nations. Do you agree with this opinion?
zh: 全球環境問題應由富裕國家負責，而非貧窮國家。你同意這個看法嗎？

en: Many people believe that global environmental problems should be dealt with internationally rather than domestically. What is your opinion?
zh: 許多人認為全球環境問題應透過國際合作處理，而非只在各國國內解決。你有甚麼看法？

en: Many animals are being hunted to the brink of extinction in order to fulfil the demand and greed of mankind for decorative purposes as well as for other reasons, such as traditional medicine. How can this issue be tackled?
zh: 為滿足人類對裝飾品和傳統藥材等的需求，許多動物遭大量獵捕，瀕臨滅絕。可以怎樣處理這個問題？

en: Restricting air travel is the only way to prevent air pollution. Do you agree?
zh: 限制航空旅行是防止空氣污染的唯一方法。你同意嗎？

en: Nowadays parents put too much pressure on their children to succeed. What is the reason for doing this? Is this a negative or positive development?
zh: 如今家長給子女過多成功壓力。原因是甚麼？這是正面還是負面的發展？

en: Some people think it is better for children to grow up in the city, while others think that life in the countryside is more suitable. What are the advantages and disadvantages of both places?
zh: 有些人認為兒童在城市成長較好，另一些人則認為鄉村生活更適合。兩種地方各有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: In many modern societies, grandchildren rarely spend any quality time with their grandparents. What do you think are the consequences of this?
zh: 在許多現代社會，孫子女很少與祖父母共度有質素的時間。你認為這會造成甚麼後果？

en: Nowadays, it seems that different generations within the family spend less time doing activities together. Why is that? Is it a positive or negative development?
zh: 如今家庭中不同世代一起活動的時間似乎越來越少。原因是甚麼？這是正面還是負面的發展？

en: Children can learn effectively by watching television. Therefore, they should be encouraged to watch television regularly at home and at school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 兒童可以透過看電視有效學習，因此應鼓勵他們在家中和學校定期看電視。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Some people think that the role of parents is to discipline their children and teach them about right and wrong. Other people consider that the main responsibility of parents is to nurture their children and provide them with a safe environment to grow up in. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為父母應管教子女，教導他們明辨是非；另一些人則認為父母的主要責任是照顧子女，提供安全的成長環境。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Most modern families have both parents working and as a result children spend less and less time with their parents. What is the reason for this? What problems can this cause?
zh: 現代許多家庭的父母都要工作，導致與子女相處的時間越來越少。原因是甚麼？這會造成甚麼問題？

en: The nuclear family is well adapted to move geographically because it is small. Do you think children benefit in any way from moving? Do you think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
zh: 核心家庭人數較少，因此較容易遷居。你認為搬家會對兒童帶來任何好處嗎？好處是否超過壞處？

en: In the past, the older generation were a source of knowledge and experience. Nowadays, the older generation have little understanding or experience of the modern world. Has this had any negative impact on the way the elderly are treated by society and the family? What could be done to solve this situation?
zh: 過去，長輩是知識與經驗的重要來源。如今，長輩對現代世界的了解和經驗可能有限。這會否對家庭和社會對待長者的方式造成負面影響？可以怎樣改善？

en: In many western countries there is an increasing number of couples choosing to have no children. What are the advantages and disadvantages to couples having no children?
zh: 在許多西方國家，選擇不生育的夫婦越來越多。沒有孩子對夫婦有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: These days people are living into their 90’s and beyond. As a result, there is increasing concern about care for the elderly. Do you think it is the responsibility of the family to care for their elderly members or should the government be held responsible?
zh: 如今不少人活到九十多歲甚至更長壽，長者照顧因而日益受到關注。照顧長者應由家庭負責，還是政府負責？

en: Children these days have more freedom than in previous generations. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
zh: 今天的兒童比以前幾代人擁有更多自由。你認為這是正面還是負面的發展？

en: The values we gain from our parents and family have more influence over our future success than any skills or knowledge learned in school. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 從父母和家庭獲得的價值觀，比在學校學到的技能或知識更能影響我們未來的成功。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Should governments make decisions about people’s lifestyle, or should people make their own decisions?
zh: 政府應決定人民的生活方式，還是讓人民自行決定？

en: A government has a responsibility to its citizens to ensure their safety. Therefore, some people think that the government should increase spending on defense but spend less on social benefits. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 政府有責任保障公民安全。因此，有些人認為政府應增加國防開支，同時減少社會福利。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that the government is responsible for the rise in obesity in children, while others think it is the fault of the parents. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為政府要為兒童肥胖率上升負責，另一些人則認為責任在父母。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that the government should give money to creative people, such as artists and musicians. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為政府應資助藝術家和音樂家等創作人。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The government should lower the budget on the arts in order to allocate more money to education. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 政府應削減藝術預算，把更多資金投放教育。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that only the government can make significant changes in society, while others think that individuals can have a lot of influence. What is your opinion?
zh: 有些人認為只有政府能對社會帶來重大改變，另一些人則認為個人也有很大影響力。你有甚麼看法？

en: The prevention of health problems and illness is more important than treatment and medicine. Government funding should reflect this. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 預防健康問題和疾病，比治療和藥物更重要。政府撥款應反映這一點。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The number of people who are at risk of serious health problems due to being overweight is increasing. What is the reason for the growth in overweight people in society? How can this problem be solved?
zh: 因超重而面臨嚴重健康風險的人越來越多。社會上超重人數增加的原因是甚麼？可以怎樣解決？

en: The amount of time spent on sport and exercise should be increased in schools in order to tackle the problem of overweight children. Do you think this is the best way to deal with the problem? What other solutions can you suggest?
zh: 學校應增加運動和體育活動時間，以應對兒童超重問題。你認為這是最佳方法嗎？還有甚麼其他方法？

en: More and more people are suffering from health problems caused by a modern life style which cannot be treated with modern medicines. Some people think that a return to traditional medicine should be encouraged. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 越來越多人患上由現代生活方式引起、現代藥物無法治療的健康問題。有些人認為應鼓勵重新使用傳統醫學。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Health care should not be provided for free regardless of a person’s income. The health of a person is in their own hands and they should, therefore, be held accountable for that. Do you agree with this opinion?
zh: 無論收入多少，醫療服務都不應免費提供。個人健康掌握在自己手中，因此應由個人負責。你同意這個觀點嗎？

en: The best way to improve health is to exercise daily. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 每天運動是改善健康的最佳方法。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that public health is the responsibility of the government while others think that people should be responsible for their own health. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為公共健康是政府的責任，另一些人則認為個人應對自己的健康負責。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Doctors should be responsible for educating their patients about how to improve their health. Do you agree with this?
zh: 醫生應負責教導病人如何改善健康。你同意嗎？

en: Walking is known to be beneficial for health and yet fewer and fewer people are walking these days. What are the reasons for this? What can be done to tackle this problem?
zh: 步行有益健康，但如今步行的人越來越少。原因是甚麼？可以怎樣應對？

en: In some countries, most people prefer to rent their homes rather than buying them. What are the advantages and disadvantages of renting a home?
zh: 在一些國家，大部分人寧願租屋，也不願買樓。租屋有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Planting trees is very important for the environment. Some people say trees should be planted in the vacant areas of cities and towns, while others say housing facilities should be built instead. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 種樹對環境非常重要。有些人認為應在城市和市鎮的空地種樹，另一些人則認為應興建房屋。你同意還是不同意？

en: Cities should be designed to be attractive for local people and foreign tourists. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 城市設計應吸引本地居民和外國遊客。你同意還是不同意？

en: Services, such as shops, schools and commercial centres should be relocated out of the city center. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 商店、學校和商業中心等服務設施應遷離市中心。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that old buildings should be protected, while others believe that they should be replaced by newer buildings. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為舊建築應受到保護，另一些人則認為應拆卸並興建新建築。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Many countries are experiencing population growth and need more homes. Should these new homes be constructed in existing cities or should new towns be built in the countryside?
zh: 許多國家人口增長，需要更多住宅。新住宅應建在現有城市內，還是在鄉郊興建新市鎮？

en: Nowadays, a lot of buildings, such as offices and schools, are now being built with an open plan design. Why is that? Do you see this as a positive or negative development?
zh: 如今許多辦公室和學校採用開放式設計。原因是甚麼？你認為這是正面還是負面的發展？

en: Cities should prioritise parks rather than housing developments. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 城市應優先興建公園，而非住宅項目。你在多大程度上同意？

en: As computers translate quickly and accurately, learning foreign languages is a waste of time. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 電腦翻譯又快又準，因此學外語是浪費時間。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Scientists predict that all people will choose to talk the same global language in the future. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
zh: 科學家預測，未來所有人都會選擇使用同一種全球通用語言。你認為這是正面還是負面的發展？

en: Some schools are no longer teaching children how to write with a pen. Do you think children should learn handwriting skills?
zh: 有些學校不再教兒童用筆寫字。你認為兒童應學習手寫嗎？

en: Some people think that a person can never understand the culture of a country unless they speak the language. Do you agree with this opinion?
zh: 有些人認為不懂一個國家的語言，就永遠無法理解該國文化。你同意嗎？

en: Some people think that you can never become fluent in a language unless you have spent time living or working in that country. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為，若沒有在某國生活或工作的經驗，就永遠無法流利使用當地語言。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that all children in school should learn a foreign language at an early age. What are the advantages and disadvantages of doing this?
zh: 有些人認為所有兒童都應在年幼時開始學外語。這樣做有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Some companies sponsor sports as a way to advertise themselves. Some people think it is good, while others think there are disadvantages to this. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些公司透過贊助體育活動宣傳自己。有人認為這是好事，另一些人則認為有缺點。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Violence in the media promotes violence in society. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 媒體中的暴力內容會促進社會暴力。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Most people think that the truth should be objective rather than subjective when it comes to the news. Do you think all news is true? What is the function of a newspaper?
zh: 多數人認為新聞應客觀呈現事實，而非帶有主觀判斷。你認為所有新聞都真實嗎？報紙有甚麼功能？

en: More and more newspapers and news channels are using photographs to support their news articles and stories. Some people think that photographs are not a reliable source of news, while others consider photographs to be irrefutable. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 越來越多報章和新聞頻道以照片支持報道。有些人認為照片不足以作為可靠的新聞證據，另一些人則認為照片難以反駁。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: The majority of news being reported is bad news such as wars, famines, accidents and crime. Why do you think that is? Do you think the news should be a balance of both good and bad news?
zh: 新聞大多報道戰爭、飢荒、意外和罪案等壞消息。你認為原因是甚麼？新聞應否兼顧好消息和壞消息？

en: In the last few decades, there have been more and more cases of famous people being hounded by the press. Some people think that famous people in the media should have no right to privacy. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 近幾十年，名人遭傳媒追逐滋擾的情況越來越多。有些人認為受傳媒關注的名人不應享有私隱。你在多大程度上同意？

en: With the development of online media, there is no future for the radio. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 隨着網上媒體發展，電台將沒有未來。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people believe that what children watch on television influences their behaviour. Others say that amount of time spent watching television influences their behaviour. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
zh: 有些人認為兒童觀看的電視內容會影響其行為；另一些人則認為影響行為的是觀看電視的時間長短。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that cinemas will one day close due to the popularity of online streaming services for films and series. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為電影和劇集串流平台日漸普及，戲院終有一天會倒閉。你同意還是不同意？

en: Companies spend millions each year on advertising online, in magazines and on billboards. These adverts can encourage people to buy goods that they do not really need. What are the positive and negative effects of consumerism?
zh: 公司每年花費大量金錢在網上、雜誌和廣告牌宣傳，可能促使人們購買不需要的商品。消費主義有甚麼正面和負面影響？

en: One of the prime times for advertising on TV is when children get back from school. Some people think that advertisements aimed at children should not be allowed. What is your opinion?
zh: 兒童放學回家後是電視廣告的黃金時段之一。有些人認為不應允許針對兒童的廣告。你有甚麼看法？

en: Some people prefer to watch foreign films rather than locally produced films. Why is this? Do you think the government should spend more money supporting the local film industry?
zh: 有些人較喜歡看外國電影，不愛看本地電影。原因是甚麼？政府應否增加對本地電影業的資助？

en: Some people think that foreign films have a negative impact on local culture. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為外國電影會對本地文化造成負面影響。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Films that are based on historical events ought to be completely accurate. Do you agree?
zh: 改編自歷史事件的電影應完全符合史實。你同意嗎？

en: Many people buy products that they do not really need and replace old products with new ones unnecessarily. Why do people buy things they do not really need? Do you think this is a good thing?
zh: 許多人購買不需要的產品，並無必要地以新產品取代舊產品。人們為甚麼會買不需要的東西？你認為這是好事嗎？

en: Many people think that fast food companies should not be allowed to advertise, while others believe that all companies should have the right to advertise. What is your opinion?
zh: 許多人認為快餐公司不應獲准賣廣告；另一些人則認為所有公司都應有廣告權利。你有甚麼看法？

en: Some people think books are losing importance as a source of information and entertainment. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為書籍作為資訊和娛樂來源，正逐漸失去重要性。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Children who start reading earlier in life perform better later on in their school studies. How important are early reading skills in a child’s academic performance? What other preschool factors influence a child’s academic success?
zh: 年幼時開始閱讀的兒童，往往在往後學業上表現較好。早期閱讀能力對學業成績有多重要？還有哪些學前因素會影響學業成功？

en: Some people think that children who spend a lot of time reading children’s story books are wasting their time which could be better used doing other more useful activities. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為兒童花大量時間閱讀故事書是在浪費時間，應把時間用於更有用的活動。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that e-books are the death of paper books, while others think that paper books will never disappear. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為電子書將取代紙本書，另一些人則認為紙本書永遠不會消失。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Libraries should focus on improving their technological resources rather than on building a larger collection of paper books. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 圖書館應優先改善科技資源，而非擴充紙本藏書。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Public libraries will soon no longer be housed in a building as all facilities and books will be available online for everyone to access. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of public libraries only existing online.
zh: 公共圖書館的設施和書籍將全面上網，圖書館很快毋須再有實體建築。討論只在網上運作的公共圖書館有甚麼優點和缺點。

en: Many countries aim to improve their living standard by economic development, but some important social values are lost as a result. Do you think the advantages of economic development outweigh the disadvantages?
zh: 許多國家透過經濟發展提高生活水平，卻因此失去一些重要的社會價值。你認為經濟發展的優點是否超過缺點？

en: In many countries women no longer feel the need to get married. Some people believe that this is because women are able to earn their own income and therefore do not require the financial security that marriage can bring. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 在許多國家，女性不再認為自己必須結婚。有人認為這是因為女性能自行賺取收入，毋須依靠婚姻提供經濟保障。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Most societies have homeless people. Some people think that the best way to help them is to give them money. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 大多數社會都有無家者。有些人認為幫助他們的最佳方法是直接給錢。你在多大程度上同意？

en: An increasing number of developing countries receive aid from international organisations to support their development plans. Some people argue that financial aid is important, while others suggest that practical aid and advice are more important. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 越來越多發展中國家獲國際組織援助，以推行發展計劃。有些人認為金錢援助重要，另一些人則認為實務援助和建議更重要。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Globalisation has both advantages and disadvantages. Discuss both and give your opinion.
zh: 全球化既有優點，也有缺點。討論兩方面，並提出你的看法。

en: In many countries, people are moving away from rural areas and towards urban areas. Why do you think that is? What problems can this cause?
zh: 許多國家的人口由鄉村遷往城市。你認為原因是甚麼？這可能造成甚麼問題？

en: The development of modern society has led to the loss of traditional ways of life. Is it important to keep our traditional ways of life? How can this be achieved?
zh: 現代社會發展令傳統生活方式逐漸流失。保留傳統生活方式重要嗎？可以怎樣做到？

en: Every culture, throughout time, has recorded its history in one way or another. In what ways can history be passed on to the next generation? Why is history important to society?
zh: 每種文化都曾以不同方式記錄歷史。歷史可以怎樣傳承給下一代？歷史為何對社會重要？

en: All societies have their own music and art. In what way are music and art important for society and for the individual?
zh: 所有社會都有自己的音樂和藝術。音樂與藝術對社會及個人有甚麼重要性？

en: The population of most cities is growing as people move to cities to find work and new opportunities. What problems does overpopulation in cities cause? How can these problems be solved?
zh: 大多數城市的人口因人們遷往城市尋找工作和機會而增加。城市人口過多會造成甚麼問題？可以怎樣解決？

en: In many cities there is a lack of space to develop and as a result, in order to modernise, old buildings are demolished and replaced with new buildings. What are the disadvantages of knocking down old buildings? Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
zh: 許多城市缺乏發展空間，因此為了現代化而拆卸舊建築，改建新樓。拆卸舊建築有甚麼缺點？其優點是否超過缺點？

en: Some people think that change in life is good for people while others believe that constant change can be too demanding on people. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為生活中的改變有益，另一些人則認為不斷改變令人難以應付。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: It is sometimes thought that people who travel outside of their own country are more tolerant and understanding of others. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為到外國旅行的人，對他人會更寬容和理解。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some scientists think that there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
zh: 有些科學家認為其他星球有智慧生命，應發送訊息與它們聯絡；另一些科學家則認為這樣做危險。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: The government is spending a lot of money to discover life on other planets. Some people think that government is wasting money and should spend more money addressing public problems. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 政府花費大量金錢尋找其他星球的生命。有些人認為這是浪費公帑，政府應把更多錢用於民生問題。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that space exploration is a waste of resources, while others think that it is essential for mankind to continue to explore the universe in which we live. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為太空探索浪費資源，另一些人則認為人類持續探索宇宙十分重要。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that dangerous sports should be banned, while others think people should be free to choose. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為危險運動應被禁止，另一些人則認為個人應有自由選擇。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that sport teaches children how to compete, while others believe that children learn teamwork. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為體育教會兒童競爭，另一些人則認為兒童從中學會團隊合作。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that introducing children to team sports is the best way to teach children teamwork. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為讓兒童參與團隊運動，是教導團隊合作的最佳方法。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Ensuring that children have regular physical exercise should be the responsibility of parents and therefore schools should not waste valuable school time having sports lessons as part of the curriculum. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有人認為確保兒童定期運動是父母的責任，因此學校不應把寶貴上課時間用於體育課。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Many countries want to host international sports events, while other countries think that hosting sports events has more problems than benefits. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 許多國家希望主辦國際體育賽事，但另一些國家認為主辦賽事帶來的問題多於好處。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Some people think that companies should provide employees with exercise time during the day. What is your opinion about this?
zh: 有些人認為公司應讓員工在工作日有時間運動。你對此有甚麼看法？

en: With an increasing overweight population some people think universities should make sport a compulsory module on all degree courses. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 隨着超重人口增加，有些人認為大學應把體育列為所有學位課程的必修科。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Professional sports people are often idolised by young children. Some people think that they, therefore, have a responsibility to be good role models at all times for children. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 職業運動員常被兒童視為偶像。有些人因此認為運動員應時刻為兒童樹立好榜樣。你同意還是不同意？

en: Some people think that sports involving violence, such as boxing and martial arts, should be banned from TV as well as from international sporting competitions. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為拳擊和武術等帶有暴力的運動，不應在電視播出，也不應列入國際賽事。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Many things that used to be done in the home by hand are now being done by machines. Does this development bring more advantages or disadvantages?
zh: 過去在家中靠人手完成的許多事情，如今由機器代勞。這種發展的優點多還是缺點多？

en: Some people argue that technological inventions, such as mobile phones, are making people socially less interactive. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為手機等科技發明令人的社交互動減少。你同意還是不同意？

en: Modern technology is now very common in most workplaces. How do you think this has changed the way we work? Do you think there are disadvantages to relying too much on technology?
zh: 現代科技已在大部分工作場所普及。你認為這如何改變工作方式？過度依賴科技有沒有缺點？

en: Some people think that the range of technology currently available is increasing the gap between rich people and poor people. Others think that it is causing the opposite effect. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為現有科技日益豐富，令貧富差距擴大；另一些人則認為科技縮小差距。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: New household appliances have resulted in more free time for women and have enabled them to both work and run a home with dependent children. What are the advantages for a family when the mother works? Do you think the disadvantages outweigh the advantages?
zh: 新家用電器令女性有更多空閒時間，也讓她們在照顧受供養子女和家庭的同時工作。母親工作對家庭有甚麼好處？缺點是否超過優點？

en: With the development of technology children are now living in a world that is completely different to what it was 50 years ago. What problems does this cause for society and the family?
zh: 隨着科技發展，今天的兒童所處的世界與五十年前大不相同。這會為社會和家庭帶來甚麼問題？

en: An increasing number of people are now using the internet to meet new people and socialise. Some people think this has brought people closer together while others think people are becoming more isolated. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 越來越多人透過互聯網結識新朋友和社交。有些人認為網絡拉近人與人之間的距離，另一些人則認為它使人更孤立。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: More and more children are accessing the internet unsupervised and at a younger age. This can sometimes put children at risk. What problems do you think parents face when dealing with their children using the internet? How can this problem be solved?
zh: 越來越多兒童從年幼時起便在沒有監督下使用互聯網，可能因此面臨風險。家長在管理子女上網方面遇到甚麼問題？可以怎樣解決？

en: Nowadays children watch a lot of TV and play video games. However, some people think that these activities are not good for a child’s mental health. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 如今兒童花大量時間看電視和玩電子遊戲。有些人認為這不利兒童心理健康。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: It is common nowadays for each member of the family to have their own piece of modern technology. Some people think this will lead to a breakdown in family relationships and communication. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 現在每名家庭成員擁有自己的科技設備十分常見。有些人認為這會損害家庭關係和溝通。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Tourism is an important industry in many countries. What benefits do you think tourism brings to individuals and society?
zh: 旅遊業是許多國家的重要產業。你認為旅遊業為個人和社會帶來甚麼好處？

en: As a result of tourism and the increasing number of people travelling, there is a growing demand for more flights. What problems does this cause for the environment? What measures could be taken to solve the problems?
zh: 旅遊業發展、旅行人數增加，令航班需求上升。這對環境造成甚麼問題？可以採取甚麼措施解決？

en: Eco-tourism usually involves people visiting remote areas. Some people think this will have a negative impact on local cultures and communities. What problems can result from eco-tourism? What measures can be taken to protect local culture and communities?
zh: 生態旅遊通常涉及到訪偏遠地區。有些人認為這會對當地文化和社區造成負面影響。生態旅遊可能帶來甚麼問題？可以怎樣保護當地文化和社區？

en: With more people choosing to watch travel programs on TV and social media, fewer people will be willing to pay the costs of traveling abroad. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 越來越多人選擇在電視和社交媒體觀看旅遊節目，因而較少人願意花錢出國旅行。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people believe that to protect local culture, tourism should be banned in some areas, while others think that change is inevitable and banning tourism will have no benefits. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為為保護本地文化，部分地區應禁止旅遊；另一些人則認為改變無可避免，禁旅遊也沒有好處。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: As a result of tourism, some historical buildings and sites are being damaged beyond repair. What could be done to prevent this?
zh: 旅遊活動令一些歷史建築和古蹟受到無法修復的損害。可以怎樣預防？

en: Some people think that when a person travels into a different culture they should adapt to the local practices and customs. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 有些人認為到另一種文化環境旅行的人，應遵守當地習俗和做法。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The development of tourism contributed to English becoming the most prominent language in the world. Some people think this will lead to English becoming the only language to be spoken globally. What are the advantages and disadvantages to having one language in the world?
zh: 旅遊業發展促使英語成為世界最重要的語言。有些人認為英語最終會成為全球唯一使用的語言。世界只有一種語言有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Many people around the world now take regular international flights. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages to the environment?
zh: 如今世界各地許多人定期乘搭國際航班。這個趨勢的優點是否超過對環境造成的缺點？

en: Raising the cost of international flights is the best way to reduce air pollution. Do you agree?
zh: 提高國際航班票價是減少空氣污染的最佳方法。你同意嗎？

en: In some cities and towns all over the world, the high volume of traffic is a problem. What are the causes of this and what actions can be taken to solve this problem?
zh: 世界各地一些城市和市鎮都面臨交通流量過大的問題。原因是甚麼？可以採取甚麼行動解決？

en: Some people think that in order to solve traffic and transportation problems people should be encouraged to live in cities rather than in suburbs or in the countryside. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 有些人認為要解決交通問題，應鼓勵人們住在城市，而非市郊或鄉村。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: The impact that the growing demand for more flights has had on the environment is a major concern for many countries. Some people believe that one way to limit the number of people travelling by air is to increase tax on flights. To what extent do you think this could solve the problem?
zh: 航班需求增加對環境的影響令許多國家憂慮。有些人認為增加航空稅能減少乘飛機的人數。你認為這在多大程度上能解決問題？

en: Some people think that it should be compulsory for people to retake their driving test every five years. What are the advantages and disadvantages of doing this?
zh: 有些人認為駕駛者應每五年重新考一次駕駛試。這樣做有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Some people think an international car-free day is an effective way to reduce air pollution. Others think there are more effective ways to do this. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為設立國際無車日能有效減少空氣污染，另一些人則認為還有更有效的方法。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: One way to solve the problem of congestion on the roads is to increase the tax on private vehicles. How could this alleviate congestion? What other measures can you suggest to deal with congestion in cities?
zh: 提高私家車稅是解決道路擠塞的一種方法。這可以怎樣紓緩擠塞？你還會建議甚麼方法解決城市交通擠塞？

en: Some people think that in order to deal with the problem of congestion in cities, privately owned vehicles should be banned in city centers, while others consider this to be an unrealistic solution. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為應禁止私家車進入市中心，以應對交通擠塞；另一些人則認為這個方法不切實際。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: Poor infrastructure hinders developing countries from progressing and modernising. Some people think that this should be the first problem tackled by foreign aid. To what extent do you agree with this opinion?
zh: 基建不足妨礙發展中國家進步和現代化。有些人認為外國援助應優先處理這個問題。你在多大程度上同意？

en: One way to solve the problem of congestion in cities is to build sky trains which run overhead rather than on or under the ground. What are the advantages and disadvantages of using this solution to solve congestion?
zh: 興建高架列車系統，而非地面或地下鐵路，是解決城市交通擠塞的一種方法。這個方法有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Some employers want to be able to contact their staff at all times, even on holidays. Does this development have more advantages than disadvantages?
zh: 有些僱主希望隨時聯絡到員工，連假期也不例外。這種做法的優點是否超過缺點？

en: More and more people are moving away from an agricultural background to relocate to cities in order to look for work. What will be the consequences of this? What solutions can you offer?
zh: 越來越多人離開農業地區，搬往城市尋找工作。這會造成甚麼後果？你有甚麼解決方法？

en: Completing university education is thought by some to be the best way to get a good job. On the other hand, other people think that getting experience and developing soft skills is more important. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
zh: 有些人認為完成大學教育是找到好工作的最佳途徑，另一些人則認為工作經驗和軟技能更重要。討論雙方觀點，並提出你的看法。

en: First impressions are important. Some people think that doing well in interviews is the key to securing a good job. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 第一印象很重要。有些人認為面試表現是找到好工作的關鍵。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Finding job satisfaction is considered to be a luxury in many developing countries. Why do you think that is? Do you think job satisfaction is important?
zh: 在許多發展中國家，找到令人滿意的工作被視為奢侈。你認為原因是甚麼？工作滿足感重要嗎？

en: Many people find it hard to balance their work with other parts of their lives. What are the reasons for this? How can this problem be overcome?
zh: 許多人難以平衡工作與生活其他方面。原因是甚麼？可以怎樣改善？

en: More companies should employ older people. What are the advantages and disadvantages for a company of doing this?
zh: 公司應聘用更多年長員工。這對公司有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Doctors, nurses and teachers make a great contribution to society and should be paid more than entertainment and sports celebrities. Do you agree or disagree?
zh: 醫生、護士和教師對社會貢獻重大，薪酬應高於娛樂界和體壇名人。你同意還是不同意？

en: Many children are encouraged by their parents to get a part time job in their free time. What are the advantages and disadvantages to children of doing so?
zh: 許多兒童獲父母鼓勵，在空閒時間做兼職。這對兒童有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: In many developing countries, there is an increasing movement of workers from rural areas into the cities. Why do you think this happens? What problems can this cause?
zh: 在許多發展中國家，越來越多工人由鄉村遷往城市。你認為原因是甚麼？這會造成甚麼問題？

en: In some developing countries, it is difficult to get good teachers to work in rural areas which can have a negative impact on the education of children in those rural communities. Why do you think good teachers do not want to work in rural areas in developing countries? What could be done to solve this problem?
zh: 一些發展中國家的鄉村難以吸引優秀教師，可能對當地兒童教育造成負面影響。為甚麼優秀教師不願到發展中國家的鄉村任教？可以怎樣解決？

en: Having a good university degree guarantees people a good job. To what extent do you agree?
zh: 擁有良好的大學學位，就能保證找到好工作。你在多大程度上同意？

en: The number of people working online from home has grown in some countries. What advantages and disadvantages can come of this trend?
zh: 一些國家在家中透過網絡工作的人越來越多。這個趨勢有甚麼優點和缺點？

en: Some people with a good education and experience in their field decide to move abroad to work. Why do you think that is? What problems does this cause?
zh: 有些人受過良好教育，並在專業領域有經驗，卻選擇到外國工作。你認為原因是甚麼？這會造成甚麼問題？

en: Paying all workers the same salary in a company promotes harmony and respect amongst colleagues. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
zh: 公司向所有員工支付相同薪酬，有助同事之間和睦相處、互相尊重。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？

en: Getting promoted is one of the main reasons people apply themselves and work hard in the modern workplace. Why do you think people are so driven to seek promotion? What other factors influence people to work hard?
zh: 晉升機會是現代職場中推動人們努力工作的重要動力之一。人們為甚麼如此渴望升職？還有哪些因素會促使人努力？

en: Bringing in foreign workers to fill positions that domestic workers are unwilling to do can cause problems in the local community and should therefore be stopped. To what extent do you agree with this?
zh: 引入外籍工人填補本地工人不願從事的職位，可能對當地社區造成問題，因此應停止這種做法。你在多大程度上同意？

en: Some people think that employers should ensure a supportive and pleasant work environment where each employee is respected and valued equally while others think employers should focus instead on providing better facilities and equipment. What is your opinion?
zh: 有些人認為僱主應營造支持員工、平等尊重每個人的愉快工作環境；另一些人則認為僱主應優先提供更好的設施和設備。你有甚麼看法？
